QR Code Generator

Create a custom QR code from any text or URL. Choose the size, foreground and background colors, and error correction level, then download it as a PNG.

Tip: use a dark foreground on a light background — QR scanners struggle with low contrast.

📖 How to use

  1. Type or paste the text or URL you want encoded.
  2. Pick a size (256, 512 or 1024 px), colors, and error-correction level.
  3. Click Generate QR Code to preview it.
  4. Click Download PNG to save the code to your device.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What can I encode in a QR code?

Any text up to a few thousand characters — URLs, Wi‑Fi credentials, contact details, or plain text. Longer content makes a denser code that is harder to scan.

What does error correction do?

It adds redundancy so the code still scans if part of it is damaged or covered by a logo. Higher levels make the code denser; Medium is a good default.

Is the generated QR code free to use?

Yes. The code is generated entirely in your browser and you can use it for personal or commercial purposes without restrictions.
